cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import time, re, resource
# timing of string strip regex on big line
data = ('{"op":"lookup","addresses":[' + ','.join('"%d::1"'%i for i in range(500000)) + ']}').encode()
print(len(data)/1e6)
t=time.time()
STR=re.compile(rb'"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"', re.S)
st = STR.sub(b'""', data)
print("strip", time.time()-t)
TBL = bytes((i if i in b'[]{}' else 32) for i in range(256))
t=time.time()
tb = st.translate(TBL)
print("translate", time.time()-t)
t=time.time()
c = st.count(b':')+st.count(b',')+st.count(b'[')+st.count(b'{')
print("count", time.time()-t, c)
EOF
